hero.heading: Get answers and transform your life
hero.subtext: Discover the missing piece to achieving lasting change, and the life you deserve

whoItsFor.heading: Mindset Coaching that gets results
whoItsFor.subtext: There comes a time in life when you find yourself on a challenging path, but can't find a clear way through.

items.text: At a crossroads, struggling to make a decision
Experiencing a big life change, like becoming a parent, or a house move
In a relationship dynamic that no longer serves you
Fed up of being the supporting role in everyone else's life
Bored of putting your own goals on pause, but struggling to make progress

banner.text: You're done going through the motions — it's time to get answers.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.body:
Friends, family, and online courses might have your best interest at heart, but they're not getting you where you want to be.

**Why?**

Because they're asking the wrong questions.

Too often, we find ourselves deferring to others for the answer, switching to autopilot, or hustling even more when things get hard.

solution.title: The Solution
solution.body:
You need a guiding light with the right roadmap, tools, and qualifications to help you truly look within.

**That's where real transformation begins.**

There's a missing piece that can make things so much simpler, if you just know how to access it:

philosophy.heading: Coaching Philosophy
philosophy.quote: Success in your outer journey starts with your inner journey.
philosophy.body:
My own experience over ten years ago taught me this profound truth.

Traditional coaching or advice doesn't properly teach us how to get curious, develop self-compassion, or gently grow our confidence as we find the answer, because we're too focussed on the external. Our judgement stays clouded.

banner.text: But when you know the first step is looking inward, everything changes.

closing.text: If you're ready to make some real decisions, let go of old habits, and bring purpose into your life again, let me be your guide.

journey.heading: What Mindset Coaching looks like
journey.subtext: This roadmap helps you move from overthinking to clear, confident action, so that you can build a life you're proud of.

steps.title: Awareness Breakthrough
steps.subtitle: The Self-Audit
steps.description: Get curious about your story. We'll audit your self‑beliefs, map where you feel stuck, and uncover repeating patterns. By week 4, you'll have a new perspective.

steps.title: Refocusing Method
steps.subtitle: Refocus & Reframe
steps.description: Work on emotions underpinning your stories. Learn emotional intelligence scripts, speak with self-compassion, and let go of limiting beliefs through gentle accountability.

steps.title: Integration
steps.subtitle: Clarity to Confidence
steps.description: Integrate insights into everyday life. Practise new habits, set boundaries, and step out of your comfort zone. Your clarity translates into decisive action.

bonus.label: Plus:
bonus.text: Resources for continued growth beyond the programme

closingCta.heading: Unclear if Mindset Coaching is right for you?
closingCta.body:
Decisions might feel hard right now. Start with a free discovery call to find out if my coaching can help you.

**We'll do the figuring out together.**

seo.title: Mindset Coaching for Women | Leeds & Online | Shanila Khan
seo.description: A 12-week, one-to-one mindset coaching programme for women ready to make clear, confident decisions. In person in Leeds or online worldwide.
